node: Data-center thermal management: chillers, liquid cooling, controls, and service
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center thermal-management node. The strongest directly supported US-listed candidates from the current evidence set are Johnson Controls as a reference-scale chiller/controls name, plus Modine, AAON, and nVent as less obvious HVAC, engineered-cooling, and enclosure/liquid-cooling suppliers. This is research-only universe expansion, not a buy/sell recommendation. The chokepoint logic is that high-density AI racks require heat rejection, chillers, liquid-cooling loops, cooling distribution, monitoring, controls, and service capacity; the key next filter is whether each candidate has verifiable data-center backlog, named hyperscaler/OEM exposure, liquid-cooling qualification, or AI-specific revenue contribution.
